# aos7-mailtodo

唯讀彙總 node 信箱中的有效信件，不修復或修改輸入資料。

## 第一次跑

```sh
python3 packs/mailtodo/bin/aos7-mailtodo <folder> --now 2026-10-09T12:00:00+08:00
```

成功時 stdout 是一行 JSON，包含 `v`、`open`、`boxes`、`bad`。`--now` 必須是帶時區的 ISO 時間；資料中的無時區時間沿用其時區。只掃描非隱藏信箱的 `inbox/*.md` 與 `inbox/done/*.md`；不遞迴、不讀取符號連結檔案。

```sh
python3 proto7-2/tests/run_all.py packs/mailtodo/tests
python3 check_answer.py <proto7-2> fixture
```

"""Black-box tests for the read-only mailtodo command."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest


ENTRY = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "bin" / "aos7-mailtodo"
NOW = "2026-10-09T12:00:00+08:00"


def write(root, relative, *, ident="x", status="REQUEST", at="2026-10-09T11:58:01", extra=""):
    path = root / relative
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text("---\nid: %s\nfrom: sender\nto: recipient\nstatus: %s\nat: %s\n%s---\nbody\n"
                    % (ident, status, at, extra), encoding="utf-8")
    return path


def run(*args):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ENTRY), *map(str, args)],
                          capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)


def snapshot(root):
    result = {}
    for path in (root, *root.rglob("*")):
        stat = path.lstat()
        result[path.relative_to(root).as_posix()] = (
            stat.st_mode, stat.st_size, stat.st_mtime_ns,
            path.read_bytes() if path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink() else None)
    return result


class MailtodoTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_open_resolution_boxes_and_read_only(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            write(root, "a/inbox/20261009T1158-request.md", ident="r")
            write(root, "a/inbox/20261009T1159-progress.md", ident="p",
                  status="PROGRESS", extra="re: r\n")
            write(root, "a/inbox/done/20261009T1100-archived.md", ident="old",
                  at="2026-10-09T11:00:00+08:00")
            write(root, "b/inbox/20261009T1159-reply.md", ident="reply",
                  status="DONE", extra="re: old\n")
            write(root, "b/inbox/20261009T1159-empty.md", ident="empty",
                  status="DONE", extra="re: \n")
            (root / "c" / "inbox").mkdir(parents=True)
            (root / ".hidden" / "inbox").mkdir(parents=True)
            write(root, ".hidden/inbox/20261009T1159-hidden.md", ident="hidden")
            write(root, "a/inbox/.20261009T1159-hidden.md", ident="hidden2")
            write(root, "a/inbox/sub/20261009T1159-nested.md", ident="nested")
            (root / "a" / "inbox" / "ignored.txt").write_text("ignored")
            (root / "a" / "inbox" / "link.md").symlink_to(
                root / "a" / "inbox" / "20261009T1158-request.md")
            before = snapshot(root)
            result = run(root, "--now", NOW)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
            self.assertEqual(result.stdout.count("\n"), 1)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads(result.stdout), {
                "v": 1,
                "open": [{"id": "r", "from": "sender", "to": "recipient",
                          "where": "inbox", "age_min": 1}],
                "boxes": {"a": {"inbox": {"REQUEST": 1, "PROGRESS": 1}, "done": 1},
                          "b": {"inbox": {"DONE": 2}, "done": 0},
                          "c": {"inbox": {}, "done": 0}},
                "bad": []})
            self.assertEqual(snapshot(root), before)

    def test_bad_precedence_duplicates_and_negative_age(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            write(root, "a/inbox/20261009T1200-a.md", ident="first",
                  at="2026-10-09T12:00:01", extra="id: shared\n")
            write(root, "a/inbox/20261009T1200-z.md", ident="shared")
            (root / "a" / "inbox" / "20261009T1200-no.md").write_text("not frontmatter\n")
            (root / "a" / "inbox" / "nonsense.md").write_text(
                "---\nid: shared\nfrom: sender\nto: recipient\nat: bad\n---\n")
            write(root, "a/inbox/20261309T1200-date.md", ident="date")
            result = run(root, "--now", NOW)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads(result.stdout), {
                "v": 1,
                "open": [{"id": "shared", "from": "sender", "to": "recipient",
                          "where": "inbox", "age_min": -1}],
                "boxes": {"a": {"inbox": {"REQUEST": 1}, "done": 0}},
                "bad": [
                    {"file": "a/inbox/20261009T1200-no.md", "why": "no_frontmatter"},
                    {"file": "a/inbox/20261009T1200-z.md", "why": "dup_id"},
                    {"file": "a/inbox/20261309T1200-date.md", "why": "bad_name"},
                    {"file": "a/inbox/nonsense.md", "why": "no_field"}]})

    def test_invalid_arguments_leave_stdout_empty(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            file_path = root / "file"
            file_path.write_text("x")
            for args in ((root,), (root, "--now", "invalid"),
                         (root, "--now", "2026-10-09T12:00:00"),
                         (root / "missing", "--now", NOW),
                         (file_path, "--now", NOW)):
                with self.subTest(args=args):
                    result = run(*args)
                    self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2)
                    self.assertEqual(result.stdout, "")
            result = run(root, "--now", NOW)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)
            self.assertEqual(result.stdout, '{"v":1,"open":[],"boxes":{},"bad":[]}\n')
            self.assertIs(type(json.loads(result.stdout)["v"]), int)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
